GuidedForms.dc.html.title: Guided controls: info icon, guide panel, provenance, quick add

n-guided.text: Guided controls. Shows the compact info icon directly above a control, its non-modal guide with explanation, steps (Back and Next), a worked example and a practice area with Reset, the clear control in every text box, the provenance line under a setting, and the quick add beside an empty state that points at Settings. Try: type a path with | in the practice box, press Reset, save a quick add. Unbuilt here: real saving (the board only shows a toast). Tweaks: seed, dark, motion.

n-ext.text: Extensions manager. Two built-in extensions with state, hooks, permissions and limits; Review opens the consent prompt, Allow turns it on, Run shows a rendered report; the master switch turns everything off. Try: Review, Keep it off, Review, Allow, Run. Unbuilt here: search, add from a folder and recent runs (built in the app). Tweaks: seed, dark, motion.

n-draw.text: Drawing. One toolbar that changes shape: pens with shortcut numbers, the palette (C) and the minimised disc (M); a board with one stroke per pen and a Shift-locked line. Try: pick pens, open the palette and pick a colour, minimise and restore. Unbuilt here: real drawing, erasing and exports (built in the app). Tweaks: seed, dark, motion (off makes every shape change instant).

n-editor.text: External editor. Detected editors with where they were found, opening the state root and receipts in VS Code, and the honest no-VS-Code state with the download offer. Try: switch the preview to no VS Code and press State root in VS Code. Unbuilt here: real detection and launching (built in the main process). Tweaks: seed, dark, motion.
